F1: end if %>` still compiles: Ruby reads the next line's output-append call as the `if` condition, which is always truthy, so the template renders, only with some whitespace reordered.
F2: cook_method raw_html` makes `cook` return `raw` without sanitizing, so feed or remote HTML (such as `javascript:` hrefs or event-handler attributes), and any later edit by the owning account, is stored and shown on the forum origin.
F3: RSS items that only have `description` give a nil `i.content`, so `.scrub` raises and the whole poll loop stops, skipping every remaining item.
F4: absolutize_urls` turns protocol-relative `//cdn.host/x` into `https://article-host/cdn.host/x`, which breaks URLs that worked before, and it leaves document-relative links pointing at the forum instead of the source article.
